messages:
sarah.p: Heads up — received a subject erasure request for an EU customer (PRIV-312). Started erasure job but found leftover keystore snapshots in a long-term GCP snapshot bucket. Need quick triage: do we have audit evidence to prove full wipe + what RBAC change is safe to run to remove the snapshots?
ben.o: Ugh, ok. Which keystore? path?
kevin.w: Can you paste the exact bucket/object names? we need to check retention policy + any legal hold flags.
sarah.p: bucket: gs://redwood-prod-keystore-snapshots/eu/keys/archived/2024-11-02/* . found 3 files that reference the subject id. I didn't delete yet — wanted to confirm procedure.
olga.m: If this is under a legal hold we must escalate to legal. If not, we should follow erasure playbook: snapshot delete -> kms key rotation proof -> audit bundle.
ben.o: For RBAC: we can create temporary service account with principle of least privilege: allow `storage.objects.delete` on that prefix only, and `logging.logEntries.list` for audit evidence. Bind for 2 hours.
kevin.w: Steps I propose: 1) snapshot the objects' hashes for chain-of-custody 2) create temp SA with only delete permission on prefix 3) run deletion in dry-run mode then actual delete 4) collect logs and keystore metadata 5) rotate key if references exist.
incident-bot: Incident PRIV-312: erasure request assigned to @sarah.p, severity: low (evidence required). Created ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRIV-312
sarah.p: @ben.o @kevin.w can you drop the RBAC snippet? I'll request the temp SA. Also need an audit query that shows deletion propagation to backups/snapshots.
ben.o: RBAC snippet (IAM binding):
```bash
# create SA
gcloud iam service-accounts create priv-erasure-312 --display-name="priv erasure 312"
# grant delete on bucket prefix via IAM condition
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member="serviceAccount:priv-erasure-312@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/storage.objectAdmin" \
  --condition="expression=resource.name.startsWith('projects/_/buckets/redwood-prod-keystore-snapshots/objects/eu/keys/archived/2024-11-02/'),title=prefix-limit,description=limit-to-prefix"
# set TTL for binding (manual cleanup expected)
```
Note: we use condition to limit scope. Confirm legal is ok.
kevin.w: Audit log query (Cloud Logging):
```bash
gcloud logging read "resource.type=\"gcs_bucket\" AND protoPayload.methodName=\"storage.objects.delete\" AND protoPayload.resourceName:\"redwood-prod-keystore-snapshots/eu/keys/archived/2024-11-02/\"" --limit 100 --project=redwood-prod
```
This shows which principal deleted which object and when.
olga.m: For backups/snapshots: we need to check snapshot lifecycle job. If snapshots are being copied to cold storage, we must list any export jobs referencing these objects. Run: `bq query` against backup manifest table or check internal replication logs.
kevin.w: Also check KMS: if keys are referenced by object metadata we must rotate the key and record the rotation event: `gcloud kms keys versions destroy` is destructive — prefer `disable` then rotate to new key and document.
sarah.p: Legal: @olga.m I marked ticket for legal review. If they sign off, I'll request the temp SA and proceed. Timeline: they want proof within 48h.
ben.o: After deletion run, capture: (a) gcloud logging read results, (b) `gsutil ls -L` output for the prefix showing no objects, (c) keystore metadata entries removed. Bundle into zip and upload to evidence S3+link to ticket.
incident-bot: PRIV-312 updated: evidence bundle requested. Reminder: don't delete until legal ack.
audit-bot: Quick check: there are two automated retention exceptions recorded last year on that bucket for compliance backups. Confirmed flags: retention_policy.locked=false, temporary_exceptions=["backup-migration-2023-07"].
kevin.w: If retention_policy.locked==false we can proceed once legal says ok. If locked, we need retention-exception-revocation via compliance team (can take 12-72h). Document this so product teams know the delay.
sarah.p: OK thanks. I'll wait for legal and then post final deletion logs here. One more ask: after delete, we should add a short data-minimization rule to prevent archiving of subject-identifying keys into snapshot prefix in future. Can someone add a short-term ticket?
olga.m: I'll create MIN-89 to add a pre-archive filter that strips subject ids from snapshot names and replaces with internal hash. Low risk.
ben.o: FYI — if anyone runs the RBAC binding command, annotate the binding with the ticket id in description so it shows up in IAM audit.
sarah.p: Thanks all. Tagging this for follow-up: once legal OKs, I'll run the sequence and post the `gcloud logging read` outputs + `gsutil -m rm` command results. :white_check_mark:
kevin.w: Thx — lean on me if you need to run the rotation step.
olga.m: Added legal contact @julia.legal to PRIV-312.
incident-bot: PRIV-312 status: awaiting legal review (2024-11-03T09:14:05Z).
